experimental_method: Degassed water equilibrated with N2 in a sealed thermostatted equilibrator for 16-48 h; vapour and liquid samples of known volume taken, N2 extracted and amounts determined by PVT measurement (Ruska quartz Bourdon manometer); Benson-Krause technique.
uncertainties_stated: Random error of H_2,1 less than +/-0.04 %; maximum systematic error about +/-0.03 %; average deviation from smoothing equations 0.038 % (CG), 0.042 % (BK). Temperature drift +/-0.003 K.
quality_remarks: N2 99.999 mol%; residual dissolved air in degassed water < 0.001 % of saturation. O2 control runs agreed with Benson et al. to 0.04 %. Authors say earlier literature values (Murray-Riley-Wilson) are 1.1-1.5 % higher. Temperature IPTS-68.

Table IV: smoothed Henry and Ostwald coefficients, enthalpies and heat capacities of solution at rounded temperatures (derived from the CG fit)
